title: Add a failing test that `isDeliverableChange` is false when `.factory/pull-requests/<change>.json` is missing, when the pull request number or URL is absent, and when the branch is not `factory/<change>`. It is true for a record with that branch, a positive pull request number, and a non-empty URL. The same test shows the stage 1 exit check fails a change when the predicate is false and accepts the record check when the predicate is true. Verify the test fails with `node --test test/pr-deliverable.test.mjs` before the predicate exists. Then add `isDeliverableChange` beside `readPullRequestRecord` in `src/lib/pull-request.mjs`, and state in the factory-openspec and factory-coordinator templates that archive runs this check first and does not move the change when it is false. Verify `node --test test/pr-deliverable.test.mjs` and `node --test test/pull-request-outer-loop.test.mjs` pass.
acceptanceCriteria: Archive and the stage 1 exit test use one predicate, and a change without a `pr open` record is not deliverable.
